events_detected.title: Ebola Outbreak Declared Global Health Emergency — 5,000+ Cases, Deadliest in DRC History
events_detected.description: WHO declared the Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in DRC a global health emergency. 4,945 confirmed cases, 2,325 deaths as of Aug 16. Fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. Spread to Uganda. Existing Ebola treatments certified for Zaire species, not Bundibugyo — complicating response.

events_detected.title: ECB Set to Deliver Additional Rate Hike — Energy Prices Pushing Inflation from Target
events_detected.description: ECB expected to raise rates once more next month (September) as high energy prices push inflation further from 2% target. Shortest tightening drive since 2011. Then keep policy unchanged through at least 2027. Yield dispersion across euro area sovereigns at historically low levels despite uncertainty.

events_detected.title: China's $148B Property Time Bomb — Expiring Land Leases, AMC Distress
